subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should this PR also exclude test-named files from installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans, or should the exclusion be limited to plugin scans only?
rationale: The diff changes a shared security-audit helper, so accepting it decides a broader scan boundary than the plugin-focused issue and proof require.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill scan coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper change only if maintainers explicitly accept the installed-skill security boundary and require proof for that broader behavior.

options.title: Pause for audit-scope policy
options.body: Hold this PR until the canonical issue settles whether test-file exclusion, string masking, or another audit strategy should be the permanent fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill scan coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit hardening work makes this the strongest available owner signal for the scan-scope security boundary.
